# VibeSOP Configuration

> **Version**: 5.4.5
> **Platforms**: OpenCode, Cursor, Kimi CLI, Pi Coding Agent

System-wide routing, tool environment, session lifecycle, and quick commands are managed by `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` for Claude Code users.
